descByPlatform.chatgpt: Create a romantic impressionist watercolor painting of a young couple standing close together in an intimate pose. The girl has long dark flowing hair with a small purple flower tucked near her ear, wearing a bright magenta dress that softly blends into the watercolor texture. The boy is dressed in a simple white shirt. Style: loose, blurry, and emotional with soft brush strokes, smudged edges, and a dreamy unfinished look. Watercolor effect should feel expressive and fluid, with gentle color bleeding and natural paper texture visible. Background is minimal — plain textured beige paper like vintage parchment with large empty negative space above the couple. The couple is positioned at the bottom-right corner of the frame. Soft pastel watercolor splashes in purple and pink appear subtly around the edges.

descByPlatform.flux: A beautifully rendered romantic impressionist watercolor painting of a young couple in an intimate standing pose, executed with authentic loose watercolor technique on textured cold-press paper. The girl has long flowing dark hair with a delicate small purple flower tucked near her ear, wearing a vibrant magenta dress that softly dissolves at its edges into the surrounding watercolor washes — the fabric rendered with fluid wet-on-wet color bleeding. The boy beside her wears a simple clean white shirt, his form rendered with warm earth-tone washes and expressive confident brushwork. The painting style is intentionally loose, slightly blurry, and emotionally charged: brushstrokes are visible and confident, edges smudge and dissolve into the paper, areas of the white paper are deliberately left unpainted for luminous effect. The background is a minimal plain textured beige — like aged vintage parchment — with a generous expanse of empty negative space above the couple, inviting text or titles. The couple is composed toward the bottom-right corner of the frame in a natural intimate arrangement. Soft pastel watercolor splashes in violet-purple and dusty rose-pink appear subtly near the frame edges, adding compositional balance. Overall: expressive, fluid, dreamy, emotionally resonant watercolor illustration aesthetic, 4:5 aspect ratio.
